  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The #8 wood screws felt like a natural next choice because I recently selected #8 construction screws; the slightly shorter length could suit a related fastening job.",
    "Recognizing my interest in fastening materials made sense given my repeated selections of framing nails, wood screws, and drywall anchors."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The short 18-gauge brads did not match my framing-nail needs: their length, purpose, and required tool differ, even though both are nails.",
    "The hose fitting, relief valve, and locking nuts require specific matching repairs or assemblies that my recent choices do not establish.",
    "Epoxy, adhesive tape, and wire brushes address bonding or cleaning tasks, while my recent hardware choices center on fastening with screws and nails.",
    "The hydrometer felt unrelated because buying medicine cups does not mean I brew drinks or need to measure alcohol content."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Being broadly related to hardware seemed to count too much, even when an item served a different task.",
    "Shared words or functions such as nails, mounting, or measuring seemed to outweigh differences in intended use and compatibility."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated interest in wood screws and framing nails provides stronger evidence of a current need than a loose connection to other repair supplies.",
    "Fastener size, length, head style, and tool compatibility matter to whether I can actually use an item.",
    "My purchases span separate household needs; medicine cups and vacuum bags do not necessarily belong to the same project as my fasteners."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my hardware interest but often missed the specific fastening tasks and compatibility details that determine what I would choose now."
}
